name: superlcm
displayName: SuperLcm — Permanent context. Turn your context into an archive.
description: Permanent context: turn your context into an archive. SuperLcm saves every Claude Code conversation word for word on your computer, files layered summaries like the chapters of a book, and lets Claude find and quote the exact original later, even after compaction. Codex, Hermes and Pi share the same archive, so a conversation can be continued in another tool.
